content: विप्रः [वप्-रन् पृषो˚ अत इत्वम्; <ls>Uṇ. 2. 28</ls>] .²1 A Brāhmaṇa; see the quotations under ब्राह्मण. .²2 A sage, wise man; त्वं मुखं पद्मजो विप्रः <ls>Mb. 1. 23. 17</ls>. .²3 The Aśvattha tree. .²4 (In prosody) A foot of four short syllables. .²5 A singer of hymns, praiser. .²6 The month भाद्रपद. .²7 Ficus Religiosa (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>पिंपळ</ns>). .²8 Acacia Sirissa (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>शिरस</ns>).
